newsitem.title: UK: Shooting in Belfast, security casualites - sources.
newsitem.headline: Shooting in Belfast, security casualites - sources.

text.p: Ambulances were rushed to north Belfast on Friday night after security forces came under attack and first reports said there were some casualties.
Details were sketchy but security sources said it appeared that members of the province's police and British troops had been injured.
The sources said the incident happened at Hillview Street in a borderline area between Protestant and Catholic zones.
One resident said he heard about 20 shots and there was an unconfirmed report of an explosion.
Security forces have come under sniper attack in the past week during violence triggered by a Protestant march along the Catholic Garvaghy road area of Portadown, south of Belfast.
